assumptions: All ten P&ID equipment items for Area 500 are present as units with their P&ID tags as unit ids in run A500-full-v5: H-512, D-501, T-512, D-502, H-503, M-503, H-506, H-507, H-509 and S-505. Auxiliary units SEP-CO2, MIX-509, MIX-523, MIX-524, MIX-512, SPLIT-514, REC-507 and REC-521 are routing/tear units only and are not claimed as P&ID equipment.

D-501 is modelled as a truncated distillation column from the vapour draw down (25 stages, feed_stage 2, Murphree efficiency 0.48, partial condenser, P_bar 2.026, vapor_mol_s 634, reflux_ratio 0.2, bottoms_mol_s 5350, reduced from 5380 in run A500-full-v4), following the simulator guidance for a large vapour side draw instead of the full 32-tray column with an explicit side draw. Its H-501 reboiler and H-504 condenser are the column-internal reboiler (reboiler_kW 66425.66) and condenser (condenser_kW 16918.58) in run A500-full-v5, not separate hx units.

DISCLOSED SOLVER ERROR in run A500-full-v5: 'D-501: Failed to fulfill mass balance for Ethanol: Relative Error = 0.00014391734034284207 [Tolerance = 0.0001]'. Reducing bottoms_mol_s from 5380 (error 0.000256 in run A500-full-v4) to 5350 reduced but did not clear this tolerance failure; no documented limit was changed to mask it, and the D-501 product streams are nevertheless reported by the solver and calibrate closely to stream 510 (see calibration). This residual solver-tolerance closure is an open finding of the submitted run.

Non-condensable CO2 is removed immediately upstream of D-501 by auxiliary component_separator SEP-CO2 (Carbon dioxide recovery 0% to the column feed, reject S509G) because the bubble-point column solver stalls on non-condensables; this is a fixed-split stand-in, not a design model of the overhead vent system. The simulator additionally stripped 0.0341 kg/h of glycol/glycerol traces from D-502 feed S510 so that column converges (run A500-full-v5 notes).

The D-501 bottoms / H-512 feed-effluent loop and the molecular-sieve regeneration return to D-502 are closed with recycle tear units REC-507 (S507C -> S507) and REC-521 (S521C -> S521) because those loop temperatures are set by the column/sieve return, per the task instruction. H-512 and H-506 are run in rating mode (U_W_m2K and installed area_m2 given, no hot_out_T_C over-specification); in trial A500-full-v3 imposing hot_out_T_C 47 on H-512 made the exchanger infeasible (64622 kW required vs 42385 kW available), so the 47 C value is retained only as the limits.out_T_C process requirement on the hot side and is reported as not met by the rating-mode outlet (S508 at 87.67 C) rather than by raising any rating.

D-502 is a rigorous distillation unit (45 stages, feed_stage [33, 14] for S510 and S521, efficiency 0.76, total condenser, P_bar 1.621, condenser_spec Reflux Ratio 3.5, reboiler_spec Boilup Ratio 3.0). Its simulated distillate S511L carries Ethanol 26002.42 kg/h and Water 17990.78 kg/h, below the near-azeotropic overhead the rectification section is intended to produce, and its Fair flood fraction is 0.987 against the 0.8 screen (utilisation 1.234 in run A500-full-v5); both are disclosed as unresolved calibration/limit findings of the as-built model, not adjusted away by changing documented geometry (diameter_m 3.96, tray_spacing_m 0.61) or limits.

M-503 (molecular sieve), T-512 (vent scrubber) and S-505 (solids filter/separator) are component_separator fixed-split stand-ins (M-503: Ethanol 99% / Water 1% recovered to the dry product; T-512: Ethanol and Acetic acid 99%, Water 50%, gases 0% to the scrubbed liquid; S-505: lumped-solids stand-ins HexaPropylene Glycol, PentaEthylene Glycol and TetraPropylene Glycol 100% to the cake stream S571, all other compounds 20%). These are not adsorption, absorption or solids-separation design models; cyclic sieve adsorption/regeneration dynamics, scrubber mass transfer and filter cake washing are not expressible in the spec and remain model gaps rather than approximated physics.

The beer and bottoms lumped organics/solids are represented by the DWSIM stand-in compounds named in the operating data sheet (glycol/glycerol stand-ins for lignin, xylan, cellulose and soluble organics) with the NRTL package; electrolyte and solids phase equilibria are not represented. Feed compositions are mole fractions back-calculated so that the simulator reproduces the data-sheet component kg/h (verified on S501: Ethanol 21940.16 kg/h, Water 378524.26 kg/h in run A500-full-v5).

Utility and boundary streams S305, S317 (fermentation/saccharification vents to the scrubber) and S524 (scrubber water) enter as boundary feeds at the data-sheet flows (1969, 19180 and 26836 kg/h); the upstream areas that produce them are outside this unit's boundary. check_coverage on run A500-full-v4 reported no missing equipment; the connections it flagged as unmodelled are routed in the model through the auxiliary units named above (H-512 -> D-501 via SEP-CO2 on S506/S506L, D-501 -> H-512 via REC-507 on S507C/S507, D-501 -> T-512 via MIX-509/MIX-523/MIX-524, D-501 -> D-502 directly on S510, D-502 -> H-503 on S511L/S511, M-503 -> H-506 via SPLIT-514 on S514 and M-503 -> H-507 via MIX-512 on S512/S512M), i.e. they carry normal flow through renamed intermediate streams rather than being omitted.

No existing limits.* rating has been raised: column limits use the P&ID geometry (D-501 diameter_m 4.27 from 14 ft and tray_spacing_m 0.61 from 24 in; D-502 diameter_m 3.96, tray_spacing_m 0.61), H-512 limits use installed area_m2 310 with out_T_C 47 on the hot side, and H-506 limits use area_m2 100.
